scope: Government, learned-society, commercial, market and transport circulation of Nepal paper before and around the 1842 pulp shipment.
central_claim: By late 1837 Nepal paper was being treated simultaneously as a Government-stationery substitution candidate, a traded commodity with distributed plains markets, a route-costed material, an experimental sample set differentiated by size and quality, a proposed Chamber of Commerce sample, and a learned-society publication object. Govindgunge appears in 1825, 1837 and 1842 in three distinct functions: Company transport-metrology destination, Nepal-paper market/supply node, and specific pulp-forwarding option.

models.archive_as_material_test: Long-lived Government office records become comparative evidence about paper durability and proof objects for prospective procurement.
models.government_substitution: paper substitution = durability/performance x price x market access x season x transport
models.sample_transformation: finished paper commodity -> classified sample set -> experimental specimen -> proposed commercial sample -> learned-society publication object
models.circulation: physical material circulation + administrative/documentary circulation + learned/commercial knowledge circulation
models.continuity_rule: Treat 1831-1842 as a recurring government paper problem-space with documented continuities and gaps, not as one uninterrupted programme unless direct continuation orders are recovered.

source_control_rules: Use the 1838 Transactions proceedings as direct primary evidence for the Society sample request, Campbell reply, Chamber proposal and copied correspondence transfer.
Use Abdul Ali 1945 as secondary archival extraction until cited primary files/pages are inspected.
Do not silently expand Political O.C.; modern series/shelfmark unresolved.
Keep proposed Chamber of Commerce forwarding separate from proven receipt/testing.
Keep Serampore Press publication separate from Serampore Paper Mills experimentation and from the unproven 1842 consignment edge.
Keep spring-1842 temporal convergence separate from causality or batch identity.
